purpose: measured levels for the j2_widefield_v2 placed-points transfers (black = background pedestal, white = disc level) — Siril stat main on box selections of the prepared frames; box placement was diagnostic (coarse block-median map), the recorded values are the tool's
units: prep = Siril stat value / 65535 (Siril prints 32f stats in the 16-bit convention); native MJy/sr = prep * divisor
notes: boxes are shared across filters (same reprojected grid); disc box is zero-free in both filters (avoids the f335m saturation crescents: 0.00%/0.01% zeros)
f335m ring box Max 0.171 is a compact source in the ansa box (moon or star); the ring level is the Median
sky pedestal is slightly NEGATIVE in f212n (background-matched mosaic) — a placed black point must tolerate that
native-domain disc ratio f212n/f335m ~= 7.9x, but the recorded prep divisors (50000/4000 = 12.5x) invert it to 0.63x — the measured mechanism behind v1's cyan-heavy balance

GEOMETRY (v2 inspection finding): disc center ~(row 3212, col 908); equator ~vertical; upper ansa at ~1.75 R_J = rows ~1900-2100 col ~908 (lower ansa off-frame bottom); the original 'ring_ansa' box (same row as center, +900 cols) lies along the polar axis = scatter fan

ring_ansa.MISNAMED: this box sits along the ROTATION-AXIS direction (bands run ~vertical in the detector frame, so the equator/ring plane is ~vertical too) — it measured the aurora-driven polar SCATTER FAN, not the ring; the true ring is in ring_ansa_true

ring_ansa_true.note: NO F212N ring signal above noise at L3 depth (median is at/below sky) — a neutral bright ring cannot come from these two L3 products; the reference's ring likely rode the original's deeper F212N group selection (L2) or finishing desaturation
